speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are presenting with rectal bleeding and a palpable rectal mass; please describe the appearance of the bleeding and any associated changes in bowel habits or weight.

speaker: Patient
text: 45-year-old female. The patient reports a 2-week history of rectal bleeding occurring daily with bowel movements. She denies any pain with defecation and does not present with any other complaints.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Rectal Carcinoma.

Given your age, the palpable mass, daily rectal bleeding, and absence of pain or bowel habit changes, these findings are highly suspicious for colorectal cancer rather than hemorrhoids or fissure. I will proceed immediately to arrange a colonoscopy with biopsy to confirm the diagnosis.
